summary: DB2CONN is the shared DB2 Connection Manager subroutine. Called with a function code, it connects to (CONN), disconnects from (DISC), or checks the status of (STAT) a DB2 database. Connect retries up to 3 times with a delay between attempts, classifying SQL errors (max-connections, network, general). Disconnect commits then resets the connection. Status runs a trivial SELECT against SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 to confirm the session is live. Errors are reported through ERRPROC. It centralises all DB2 connect/disconnect logic for the online and batch programs.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE function
  WHEN 'CONN': CALL 1000-CONNECT
  WHEN 'DISC': CALL 2000-DISCONNECT
  WHEN 'STAT': CALL 3000-CHECK-STATUS
  ELSE: SET error 'Invalid function code'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
END SELECT
RETURN (GOBACK)

paragraphs.name: 1000-CONNECT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET disconnected; RESET retry count = 0
SET WS-DB-NAME = LS-DB-NAME; SET WS-PLAN-NAME = LS-PLAN-NAME
WHILE NOT connected AND retry count < 3 DO
  SQL CONNECT TO :WS-DB-NAME
  IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN SET connected; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 0
  ELSE INCREMENT retry count; CALL 1100-HANDLE-CONN-ERROR END IF
  IF retry count < 3 AND NOT connected THEN CALL 'DELAY' (wait before retry) END IF
END WHILE
branches: WHILE NOT connected AND retries<3 (retry loop)
IF SQLCODE=0 -> connected else handle error
IF retries left AND not connected -> DELAY

annotations.note: Bounded retry (max 3) with a DELAY between attempts — resilient connect, unlike INQHIST's unbounded recursion.

paragraphs.name: 1100-HANDLE-CONN-ERROR
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET LS-SQLCODE = SQLCODE
SELECT CASE SQLCODE
  WHEN -30081: msg 'Maximum connections exceeded'
  WHEN -99999: msg 'Network error connecting to DB2'
  ELSE: msg 'General DB2 connection error'
END SELECT
SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 12

paragraphs.name: 2000-DISCONNECT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
IF connected THEN
  SQL COMMIT WORK
  SQL CONNECT RESET
  IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN SET disconnected; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 0
  ELSE SET LS-SQLCODE=SQLCODE; msg 'Error disconnecting from DB2'; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 8 END IF
END IF
branches: IF reset SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error

annotations.note: Commits outstanding work before disconnecting so no uncommitted changes are lost.

paragraphs.name: 3000-CHECK-STATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL SELECT CURRENT SERVER INTO :WS-DB-NAME FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN SET connected; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 0
ELSE SET disconnected; SET LS-SQLCODE=SQLCODE; msg 'DB2 connection not active'; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 4 END IF
branches: IF status SELECT SQLCODE=0 -> active else not active

annotations.note: SELECT CURRENT SERVER FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 is the standard cheap ping to test a live DB2 connection.

paragraphs.name: 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET ERR-PROGRAM = 'DB2CONN'; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 12
CALL 'ERRPROC' PASSING ERR-MESSAGE

usage.note: Produced by Claude Code in-session; no API call, no key, no token cost.
